claim: Work 3 controls the admissible path set independently of frozen M3 route ranking; any benefit must be explained by the batch-concentration versus congestion-bypass tradeoff.

candidate.base: canonical edges plus the previously frozen static slow-link detours
candidate.dynamic_escape: For each other legal cross-replica compute edge, compare observed GPU-release plus link-release and prompt-transfer pressure against the least-pressure canonical successor of the same tail. Admit only if relief exceeds the positive difference in marginal decode-batch GPU work for a 154-token median output.
candidate.batch_penalty: 154 is the preexisting pooled seed-100 trace median output length in v3_cohort_routing/protocol_dev.json. For candidate and reference successor, estimate one decode round with currently active sessions versus one added session, using profiled batch times and the simulator's batch-1 doubling. Multiply max(0, marginal candidate work minus marginal reference work) by 154. No actual future output length is read.
candidate.ranking: The frozen V3 M3 queue/link/KV cost and route tie order are unchanged after edge admission.
candidate.kv_guard: All comparison cells use the same executed-layer full-lifetime KV admission from v3_cluster42/kv_admission.py. Capacity waiting is reported, never treated as an unobserved gain.

go_rule: Proceed to formal only if dynamic selects a non-static detour in at least one high-load condition, and vs static on each high-load condition throughput changes by at least -0.5% and P95 TPOT changes by at most +2%, with strictly lower P95 TPOT in at least one. Keep all failures and negative results.
prior_smoke: Version 1 used a standalone batch-1 versus typical-batch penalty times 154. In both 60-second high-load windows it admitted zero additional edges, so no dynamic policy was actually exercised. Those raw windows remain under runs/smoke; version 2 uses relative marginal batch cost and will be screened with fresh 300-second development windows. No formal window has been run.
mechanism_observables: decode mean batch and single-request share
GPU busy seconds per output token
KV peak reservations, admission waiting and capacity failures
throughput, P95 TTFT/TPOT, completion and backlog
boundaries: M1 has no standalone contribution claim
42-node validation is a paired scale check only after candidate freeze
No claim from a development window or a three-seed mean alone
